reuse.why: Copies the eight-field 'clear the link' update out of unlinkAccount instead of extracting it into a shared helper that both the unlink action and the takeover could call.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: A state-changing unlink is put inside ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, a validation guard whose name says it only checks, and it runs before the rest of the link work rather than as an explicit step of the link flow.

scope.why: Mostly focused on the flag and its threading through the six providers; it also reformats an unrelated test query.

maintainability.why: A boolean that turns a guard into a mutator, plus a copied unlink block that will drift from unlinkAccount, would surprise a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the old account's link with its own db.updateAccount instead of going through the unlink logic in unlinkAccount (or a helper extracted from it).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink update is verbatim, not disguised.
